name: Nordreth Cabinet 160 AgenticGEO
description: This ambient-floor audition vault is a top-tier solution for professional sound testing and critical listening applications. With a spacious 65-square-metre floor area, an impressively low noise floor of just 15 dBA, and capacity for up to 24 people, it is meticulously designed to deliver outstanding acoustic performance. Each session lasts 4 hours, and fees are determined after acceptance to ensure a customized experience. Advanced mass wall construction provides exceptional sound isolation, effectively blocking external noise and interference. All technical specifications are clearly outlined across six key performance axes, meeting the highest standards for acoustic chambers, rehearsal studios, and controlled environment rooms.
